title: Pinsir's Clamp Has a Brutal Fallback
premise: Pinsir follows a brutal two-step rule: tear prey apart, or fling away anything it cannot crush.
audiencePromise: See how Pinsir turns one failed clamp into a second, violent outcome.
openLoop: What does Pinsir do when tearing prey apart fails?
payoff: Pinsir's pincers are both a trap and a launch: they tear prey apart or throw it hard.
engagementQuestion: Which sounds worse: being split apart, or being tossed hard?

voice.instructions: Speak quickly and clearly with warm, darkly playful energy. Stress tearing fails, swings, and tosses. Pause briefly before the final choice.

scenes.headline: WHEN TEARING FAILS
scenes.narration: Pinsir's backup plan starts when tearing fails.
scenes.caption: THE ATTACK HAS A SECOND STEP

scenes.headline: CLAMP UNTIL IT TEARS
scenes.narration: Its pincers grip prey until the prey is torn in half.
scenes.caption: THE PINCERS HOLD ON

scenes.headline: THE ATTACK CHANGES
scenes.narration: If crushing fails, Pinsir swings the prey around instead.
scenes.caption: FAILED CRUSH. NEW MOTION.

scenes.headline: FAILURE BECOMES A THROW
scenes.narration: The failed crush still ends with the prey tossed hard away.
scenes.caption: CAN'T TEAR IT? TOSS IT.

scenes.headline: TRAP OR LAUNCH
scenes.narration: Its pincers work as both a trap and a launch.
scenes.caption: TEAR IT OR TOSS IT

scenes.headline: WHICH SOUNDS WORSE?
scenes.narration: Which sounds worse: being split apart, or being tossed hard?
scenes.caption: SPLIT OR TOSSED?
